description.value:
The wise and gentle nu mous, a tribe of lop-eared mages and spellcasters, are famous for their thirst for learning.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Nu mous gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Constitution.
  • Type: Nu mous are Humanoid creatures with the nu mou subtype.
  • Size: Nu mous are Small creatures.
  • Base Speed: Nu mous have a base speed of 20 feet.
  • Languages: Nu mous begin play speaking Common and Numish. Nu mous with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Banganese, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Moogle, Sylvan and Vieran.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Sagacious: Nu mous receive a +2 racial bonus on any two Knowledge skills, which count as class skills.
  • Well-Spoken: Nu mous receive a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Handle Animal checks.

Magical Racial Trait

  • Adept: Nu mous gain a +1 bonus to caster level. Nu mous with Intelligence 11+ can cast three 0-level black mage spells once each per day.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Nu mous can see twice as far as humes in dim light.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Poor Swimmer: Nu mous take a –4 penalty on Swim checks.
